primary_diagnosis_treated: Diabetes mellitus type 2 (prediabetes/early T2DM) with chronic kidney disease stage 3-4

medications.nice_justification: Statin therapy recommended for dyslipidaemia or QRISK ≥10% (NG28).

medications.purpose: First‑line glucose‑lowering therapy in CKD eGFR 20‑30 mL/min/1.73 m² where metformin is contraindicated
medications.nice_justification: NG28 recommends SGLT2 inhibitor alone when metformin contraindicated (eGFR <30) (first_line_treatment).

medications.purpose: Add‑on therapy for glycaemic control in CKD eGFR 20‑30 mL/min/1.73 m² (renal‑safe, no dose adjustment)
medications.nice_justification: NG28 advises SGLT2i + DPP‑4 inhibitor for CKD eGFR 20‑30 mL/min/1.73 m² (by_comorbidity).

interactions_checked.interaction: No clinically significant pharmacokinetic interaction; monitor for volume depletion if diuretics are added.
interactions_checked.action: No dose change required; advise adequate hydration.

contraindications.reason: Renal impairment (creatinine 3.3 mg/dL suggests eGFR ≈20‑30 mL/min/1.73 m²); NICE contraindicates metformin if eGFR <30.
contraindications.alternative: SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin) + DPP‑4 inhibitor (linagliptin) as prescribed.

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided; assumed 20‑30 mL/min/1.73 m² based on serum creatinine 3.3 mg/dL. Formal eGFR measurement required before finalising regimen.
Potassium 5.2 mmol/L is mildly elevated; if an ACE‑I or ARB is considered later, monitor potassium closely.
Albumin‑to‑creatinine ratio (ACR) not available; order to assess need for ACE‑I/ARB renal protection.
Liver function tests not provided; verify normal LFTs before any statin dose increase.
Allergy status unknown; confirm no hypersensitivity to dapagliflozin, linagliptin, or statins.
Smoking status not recorded; assess and advise cessation if applicable.
Exact BMI value not recorded; obesity confirmed (BMI ≥ 30) – reinforces need for lifestyle intervention.
treatment_summary: Start dapagliflozin 10 mg daily and linagliptin 5 mg daily as first‑line oral therapy for early type 2 diabetes with CKD stage 3‑4, because metformin is contraindicated (eGFR <30). Continue existing simvastatin for hyperlipidaemia, and maintain current analgesic regimen. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, HbA1c, and for SGLT2‑i related infections. Provide structured diabetes education, weight‑loss and exercise advice per NG28.
